acceptedStream: Got it! A painter is starting on your picture now. You can watch it paint live at {streamUrl}, and I'll reply here with the painting when it's done.
doneStream: Here's your painting! The live stream at {streamUrl} has ended.
doneLimitStream: Here's your painting. The painter stopped before it was finished, so this is where it got to. The live stream at {streamUrl} has ended.
acceptedStreamDry: Got it! This is a dry run, so no painter starts and no stream runs at {streamUrl}.
doneStreamDry: This was a dry run, so no painting was made and no stream ran at {streamUrl}.
streamTitle: Stillwet is painting a request live
accepted: Got it! A painter is starting on your picture now. I'll reply here with the painting when it's done.
queued: Thanks! You're at position {position} in line. A painter will start on your request when one is free, and I'll reply here with the painting when it's done.
declinedPolicy: Sorry, I can't paint this one. I don't paint real people, sexual content, hate or graphic gore.
declinedCheck: Sorry, I couldn't check your request just now, so I can't take it. You're welcome to send it again later.
declinedLimit: Sorry, a request limit has been reached, so I can't take this one.
declinedSize: Sorry, that request is too long for me to take. A shorter description would fit.
declinedQueue: Sorry, the line is full right now, so I can't take your request.
doneLimit: Here's your painting. The painter stopped before it was finished, so this is where it got to.
doneDry: This was a dry run, so no painting was made.
failed: Sorry, something went wrong at the easel and your painting didn't get made.
stopped: Done. You're opted out and any pending request is canceled. Your opt-out stays in place, and a new request won't turn it back on.
expired: Sorry, your request expired before a painter slot opened, so it's been closed.
imageAlt: An oil painting made for this request.
